claim_tested: RFT1 is MOP alternating-access transporter with cationic central cavity + lateral dolichol portal
key_finding: AF3/Chai-1 yeast Rft1-M5-DLO models show alternating access; cationic cavity binds anionic headgroup, dolichol tail exits lateral portal; 2/26 cavity mutants poor growth; portal-blocking mutant (predicted no scramblase) grew robustly
context: yeast Rft1, Tet-off reporter, in silico + in vivo
confidence_limitations: High for architecture; suggests scrambling may be moonlighting (leans Model B); yeast not human

key_finding: Proposes cavity/portal scrambling mechanism for the anionic glycolipid

claim_tested: Purified Rft1 is itself the M5-DLO translocase (GO:0140303)
key_finding: Fully reconstituted assay: purified Rft1 catalyzes transbilayer translocation of M5GN2-PP-Dol with substrate selectivity
confidence_limitations: Strong direct MF evidence; in vitro only; does not localize disease residues

claim_tested: R67C/K152E/E298K cause RFT1-CDG via M5-DLO accumulation
key_finding: Three unrelated patients homozygous for R67C, K152E, E298K; M5GlcNAc2-PP-Dol accumulates; rescued by WT RFT1
confidence_limitations: Establishes disease residues; loss-of-function, not mechanism of translocation

key_finding: First patient: severe multisystem CDG; DolPP-GlcNAc2Man5 accumulation
confidence_limitations: Clinical; flippase role stated as hypothesis

claim_tested: CDG residues line central headgroup cavity not lipid portal
key_finding: R67 buried near-axis inward (cavity, high conf); K152 inner vestibule (moderate); E298 exposed outward-facing (neither cavity nor portal)
context: AF-Q96AA3-F1 v6 human apo model, Shrake-Rupley SASA + pore-axis geometry
confidence_limitations: Apo model, no docked substrate; membrane axis geometric; borderline residue membership axis-sensitive

claim_tested: Conservation of cavity charge at disease positions
key_finding: R67 invariant Arg 9/9; K152 conserved basic (K/R) 7/9; E298 conserved acidic (E/D) 9/9
context: NW alignment human vs 9 orthologs human->fungi->Dictyostelium
confidence_limitations: Small ortholog set; pairwise NW not full MSA

key_finding: ~12-14 TM two-lobed bundle; internal C2 repeat 40 CA @ 3.07 A RMSD; apo axis lining net -2 (not net-cationic)
confidence_limitations: Repeat modest (17% N-half); no experimental structure; cationic pocket comes from docked models
